reviews.comment:
Buen lugar para tomar café... Por otro lado deje el auto y me pegue una escapada a la feria del libro a 2 cuadras,  cuando volví el de seguridad me dijo que no puedo dejar el auto e irme, le indicó que fue un momento y que ahora iba a consumir dentro del recinto y de mala gana me indicó que le da igual, Nose que ley o cartel indica que en el sector de estacionamiento podes estar equis cantidad de tiempo, la verdad yo no lo vi... lo peor casi todos los espacios de estacionamiento estan ocupados por los vehiculos de los trabajadores del lugar.. En fin hipocresía..

(Translated by Google)
Nice place for coffee... On the other hand, I left my car and took a quick trip to the book fair two blocks away. When I returned, the security guard told me I couldn't just leave my car and go. I explained that I was only there for a moment and that I was going to buy something inside, and he reluctantly told me he didn't care. I don't know what law or sign indicates that you can stay in the parking area for a certain amount of time; I honestly didn't see it. The worst part is that almost all the parking spaces are occupied by the employees' vehicles. In short, hypocrisy.
